gate: Populated only after freeze-procedure-v1.0.md §3 steps 1-8 and the reveal-packet release gate are complete.

project_element.note: A single requirement of the programme formulation.

role_a_element.note: Verbatim quotation from Role A, or null if none.

structural_relation.note: Descriptive only. Never converted to better/worse.

recovery_class.note: Only the first two carry strong weight without further argument.

argument.note: Required for LOGICAL_CONSEQUENCE and NATURAL_REFORMULATION. Must use no premise Role A did not supply.

auxiliary_definitions_introduced.note: If non-empty, recovery_class is FORCED_RECONSTRUCTION by definition.

machinery_charged.note: Decoders, interpreters, schedules, lookups, side-channels needed to reproduce the project requirement from Role A's.

reverse_mapping.note: Role A elements with no counterpart in the programme formulation. REQUIRED. Omitting this direction produces a one-sided comparison and invalidates the mapping.

failed_mappings.note: Preserved, never discarded. Each with the exact reason it failed.

project_criterion_applied.note: Applying a project criterion where Role A supplied one, or supplying one where they did not, invalidates the adjudication.

mapper_declarations: I did not alter, strengthen, weaken, reinterpret, or repair Role A's formulation.
I introduced no auxiliary definition absent from Role A in order to produce agreement.
I applied no withdrawn rubric and no project-supplied dimension set.
I did not classify the outcome.
